findings.title: _fetch_one() opens a new HTTP client for every provider
findings.body_markdown: A client per call (line 32) repeats the TLS handshake eleven times a night; one shared client is enough.

findings.title: fetch_settlements() waits forever if one provider never answers
findings.body_markdown: `asyncio.gather()` over every provider has no timeout (line 14), so one hung provider stalls the nightly job past its window and no settlement is booked.
